name: Waimen Kyoukan -Nakadachi Taizou-
source:
Main character works as an instructor at a driving school. One day he gets seduced by a female student. She gets into a horrible traffic incident and dies. As investigation unfolds, main character gets suspected in sexual relations and is recommended to quit school in a month's time. Without anything to lose anymore, he has his revenge over the female students of the school.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
